By Kola Olatunde · AI C

Measuring AI ROI: The Framework That Separates Real Impact from Expensive Experiments

The real ROI of AI is rarely where the business case promised. It shows up in cycle time, defect rate, and capacity unlock — and it requires a measurement discipline most organisations never build. Without that discipline, AI spend looks like cost; with it, AI becomes the highest-leverage line on the operating P&L.

INSIGHTS · MARCH 18, 2026

Why Most Enterprise AI Deployments Fail — and What Separates the Ones That Succeed

Most enterprise AI strategies fail at the whiteboard, not the model. Industry data from McKinsey and BCG consistently puts the failure rate of enterprise AI initiatives between 70% and 85% — and the pattern repeats: the strategy was a deck, not a deployment plan, and the organisation was never actually ready to ship.
